description: Pre-existing (NOT introduced by fz-k22.7; fz-k22.7 narrows its blast radius). native_codegen/driver.rs:996-999 loop 2 fills capture surfaces for target_fns reached SOLELY via a bare direct_target hint with no NativeCallableBoundary. Its self-consistency check debug_assert_eq!(previous, &next) is compiled out in release builds. If such a target_fn is reached from >=2 call sites whose derived capture counts DISAGREE, a release build silently picks whichever call sites arithmetic ran first -- a latent silent-miscompile class for direct-only closures with no boundary. fz-k22.7 made covered targets authoritative (narrower exposure) but did not eliminate this uncovered-target path. FIX: make the disagreement a real hard error (like fz-k22.7 Layer C), not a release-stripped debug_assert -- never trade a clean crash for a miscompile.
title: native codegen: build_codegen_closure_targets self-consistency debug_assert_eq is release-mode-silent for direct-only closures with no boundary
